market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $75,000 in May?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at $80-82K. Dropping to $75K in May requires ~7-9% pullback over remaining 24 days. With current bullish trend and positive macro (Iran de-escalation, AI stocks rallying), a deep dip is less likely but volatility makes it possible. Historical monthly drawdowns of 7-9% occur ~30% of the time.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Sudden risk-off event or crypto deleveraging
